name: orchestrate-project
description: Compute a stack order from a work-group's real dependency graph, dispatch one autonomous implementer per eligible item into its own Compozy worktree cut from its parent's branch, and babysit every PR through CI and review until a human can merge the stack.

default_tracker.title: Default tracker
default_tracker.description: Tracker offered first by /orchestrate-init. A machine-level convenience only: the authoritative choice per repository is the tracker key in .orchestrate-project.json, which is committed.

compozy_pin.title: Pinned Compozy version
compozy_pin.description: The exact Compozy version references/runner.md was captured against, prerelease identifier included. /orchestrate-init warns when the installed build differs. A bump is a re-verification trigger, not an automatic upgrade.
